description: Sign in to Raspberry Pi Connect: opens a Chrome window on this computer where the USER signs in by hand (tell them to do so). Waits up to wait_sec for it; if still in progress, call account later. fresh=true signs out the current account first (switch account). The new session is used right away.

fresh.description: Sign out first (current session backed up), to switch account

wait_sec.description: Seconds to wait for the user to finish

name: login
